title: Multimodal LLM-based Agents
reading: The slide contrasts a non-agentic, zero-shot workflow with an agentic workflow for a multimodal task. The prompt given is to create a database of runner faces and corresponding bib numbers. Under the agentic framing, the task decomposes into a numbered plan: detect faces as bounding boxes, detect bib numbers as text plus bounding boxes, match each bib to the vertically closest face, write a record pairing face and bib into the database, and repeat across all frames of the video. Surrounding labels (START, FINISH, Planning/Testing, Coding) evoke an iterative agent loop over a race scene. Credited to Andrew Ng.

visuals.description: Race-imagery layout with START and FINISH markers and cycle labels 'Planning', 'Testing', 'Coding' framing the two workflow columns (zero-shot vs. agentic step list).
visuals.assertion: Agentic workflows replace a single zero-shot pass with an iterative plan-code-test loop over decomposed subtasks.
